description: This file defines a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that transforms raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels, suitable for display in a frontend UI. It handles null/undefined inputs, replaces underscores and hyphens with spaces, collapses multiple spaces, and converts strings to Title Case while preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable, title-cased label, handling various edge cases like null inputs and multiple delimiters.
